findings.title: Fire as reversed orientation

findings.reader_payoff: The Fire becomes perceptible as an outcome in which a force associated with visibility has turned against the wrongdoer, rather than only as a remote punishment location.
findings.containment: The ordinary punitive destination remains intact. This does not say Fire lexically means guidance, that every wrongdoer is darkness, or that this contrast is the only live reading.

findings.reader_payoff: The non-retaliating speaker's restraint becomes an active redirection of the matched account: the act is answered without requiring the victim to reproduce the killing by hand.
